about: How each ability-art asset is lifted out of its editable source under design/abilities/source/. A layer is exported alone in its own box, with the patterns it uses. Built by design/tools/abilities-assets.mjs into design/abilities/assets/. A proposal outside the reviewed manifest design-0.2.0, adopted only through Integration.

bundle.name: abilities
bundle.audience: private art: drawn only inside a seat's own open private sheet
bundle.loadPolicy: Every player phone, once, with the player bundles (public-board, player-ui, roles), before the first match view, whatever the seat's role, state or turn. The table display does not load it. Which requests a phone makes says nothing about its role.

neutral.about: Paper, ink and steel only: no team accent, no room color, no crew color, so no piece of the kit can be told apart by role, team or character.

rights: Original vector artwork made for this repository by the Visual and Motion Designer (Claude Code session) for Mothership. No third-party artwork, font, photograph or generated raster image is used. The portraits drawn into a file are the approved crew cards (design/source/crew/, design-0.2.0), referenced, not copied.

assets.title: Cork of a private file
assets.use: Tiled behind a private file (background-repeat), at 96 CSS px or smaller.

assets.title: A strip of tape
assets.use: Across a file's top corners, turned 35 to 45 degrees.

assets.title: A push pin
assets.use: Holds every snapshot and the envelope; one drawing for every candidate.

assets.title: A snapshot frame
assets.use: Around a player's chosen crew card: the portrait fills the window. One frame for every candidate alike.

assets.title: A query tag
assets.use: On the corner of every candidate's snapshot alike: this one is not known.

assets.title: A magnifying lens
assets.use: Marks what can be inspected; never a result.

assets.title: A paper clip
assets.use: Holds a slip to an envelope.

assets.title: A rubber-stamp frame
assets.use: Around a live word stamped on a file (CLASSIFIED, ONE EACH). The word is live text, never drawn.

assets.title: An open envelope, behind what it holds
assets.use: Behind a slip that stands in it; the front layer goes over the slip.

assets.title: An open envelope, in front of what it holds
assets.use: Over the lower part of a slip that stands in the envelope.

assets.title: A closed folder
assets.use: The cover of any private file while it is hidden: the same for every role.

assets.title: A printout
assets.use: The paper of a private result (a Scan's), stretched to the width it needs; its words and stamp are live text.

assets.title: A portrait chip
assets.use: Around a small crew card: a printout's player, a pick in the Code card. One chip for every player alike.

assets.title: The Code's mark
assets.use: Says the Code: a punch card with four holes, two by two, a set and not a row. Struck through by the client for not in the Code.

assets.title: A Code card
assets.use: Behind a Code attempt's picks in the action strip: four windows, filled in seat order.

assets.title: A vial
assets.use: One Rescue left, in the Cracker's own strip and card: the full ones first, as many as the view's count (self.rescuesRemaining).

assets.title: An empty vial
assets.use: A Rescue used: its use is reserved when the Rescue is accepted (V1-15), and the vial is drawn empty when the view's count falls, never ahead of it.

assets.title: A cross ring
assets.use: Round the chip of a Rescue's target, in the Cracker's strip only.

assets.title: A charge cell
assets.use: The one Disable a match gives, while the server offers it; the same cell for the Blue and the Red Disabler.

assets.title: An empty cell
assets.use: The Disable spent, on its receipt: its use is reserved when it is accepted (V1-15).

assets.title: Sparks
assets.use: Four sparks at the corners of a Disable's target, outside its chip: a charged reticle, never a hit. In the Disabler's strip only; the same for both Disablers.

assets.title: A shipping tag
assets.use: One of a Supply's two picks, its chip at (42, 20); the two in seat order.

assets.title: A slip
assets.use: The paper of a note in the seat's own card: the Cracker's Rescues left, a Supply's delivery, a weapon received. Nine-sliced at 18 34 10 10: the perforation in the top band, the shading in the right band.

assets.title: A reticle
assets.use: A ring and four ticks round the chip of a shot's target, in the shooter's strip only; the same for every seat that holds a weapon, the Officer included.

assets.title: A shield
assets.use: Behind the chip of a Protection's target, in the Undercover's strip and on its own note of the Protection in the card. Never on the recipient's phone or a public surface (V1-17).

assets.title: A shield used up
assets.use: A Protection the view says is used up (knowledge.protections[].consumed), on the Undercover's own note only.

assets.title: A round
assets.use: One ordinary weapon the seat holds (self.ordinaryWeapons), in its own shot strip and its own card.

assets.title: A round spent
assets.use: The weapon a registered shot used: drawn when the view's count falls, never ahead of it.
